inputs.text: DHS announced that ICE arrested an illegal immigrant gang member after New York City authorities released him despite the danger he posed to public safety. According to DHS, this case highlights tensions between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, with the agency criticizing the city's actions and pointing to the potential public safety risks of releasing individuals with criminal records.
